review: Independently reviewed all 19 exact test call paths. Request deserialization and block construction are pure. Manager tests use SessionState, Noop emitter and in-memory channels for accepted, rejected, cancelled, cleared and switched provider/model snapshots, including strict-to-legacy turns; Office has no mentioned scene and memory has no installed database handle, so both return before external access. Five SDK-effort tests exercise only pure level resolution, exact request validation, argv and YAML patch construction, plus a content-hash cache using private temporary JSON and a non-executed placeholder file. These tests never call native inspect/run_probe, load an installed SDK, initialize an Agent/Session, install anything or launch a CLI process. WhatsApp relay/health suites and all database-dependent tests remain compile-only. No AppDatabase, SQLite, SQL, migrations, agent processes or network are executed. The separately reviewed six Node tests use pure wire checks, mock metadata/selection and a read-only temporary settings backend; the runner apply and SDK probe entry points are not called.
